crossRefs.note: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth:
You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?
If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.
Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me…
keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the…
‘Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means…

translations.web: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.
translations.bsb: If I sinned, You would take note, and would not acquit me of my iniquity.
translations.kjv: If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.
translations.asv: If I sin, then thou markest me, And thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.
